text: Meeting deadlines can feel stressful, but it becomes much easier with a few simple strategies. Good time management is the foundation: break large projects into smaller tasks and set daily goals. Prioritization is also vital, so identify which tasks are most important or urgent and tackle those first. Another key skill is scope management. If a project seems too large, do not be afraid to ask for clarification or to reduce unnecessary details. Finally, communication matters. If you are falling behind, let your team or manager know early. They may offer help, adjust expectations, or extend the timeline. Remember, a deadline is not just a date; it is a promise you can keep with planning, honesty, and flexibility.
